title: Remove Gateway card and enforce native-only telemetry capability
acceptance_criteria: Gateway Status is removed from Add Card options.
Saved gateway-status cards are filtered out on dashboard load.
Gateway probe capability is marked unsupported when API ping commands are unavailable.
CPU temperature capability is marked unsupported when API sensor commands are unavailable.
Unsupported telemetry is hidden in UI instead of showing repeated failing warnings.
Backend tests and runtime smoke pass after restart.
assumptions: Native API support is the only allowed capability source for gateway probe and CPU temperature telemetry.
Unrelated dirty files in the working tree are pre-existing and out of scope for this hotfix.

tasks.notes: Removed SSH fallback, added capability flags (probe_supported/cpu_temperature_supported), and kept API contracts additive.
Removed Gateway card from dashboard surface and hid unsupported telemetry fields in card UI.
Replaced SSH fallback assertions with unsupported-capability assertions and validated targeted suites.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_gateway_summary.py tests/test_system_dashboard_temperature.py tests/test_system_lldp_parsing.py tests/test_safe_apply.py
